machinery.note: Pressure is a normalized runtime pressure proxy, not the discharge gauge. Five-band shader support and a separate winding node are pending.
Ultimate meter_fill is normalized 0..1. Fill is exposed without inventing a 1 Hz clock fact; breathing shader support is pending.
Line load spins the drum forward as a starting cue. Cable payout direction and haul speed are not available from line_load; no directional travel claim.
A rising line load kicks the pawl as a load cue. Bank Shot bite timing is carried by the SpoolBrake cast driver, not this row.
Normalized ultimate meter scales to four wrench levels. Quantization and indexed emission require shell shader support.
The rack turns during wind-up, holds through flight and eases back outside it.
Flight opens the hatch as a phase cue. This row makes no per-beat stake, puff or sound claim.
